[{"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"crash report","code":"libFuzzer ASAN report for radio-receive-done-fuzzer","note":"The vulnerable input reaches MLE parent-response handling through the radio-receive-done fuzz target."},{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/openthread/src/core/net/udp6.cpp","function":"ot::Ip6::Udp::HandleMessage","line":433,"var":"socket->HandleUdpReceive(aMessage, aMessageInfo)","code":"socket->HandleUdpReceive(aMessage, aMessageInfo);","note":"UDP dispatch removes the UDP header and forwards the attacker-controlled packet payload into the registered MLE receive handler."},{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/openthread/src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"ot::Mle::Mle::HandleUdpReceive","line":2800,"var":"command","code":"case Header::kCommandParentResponse: HandleParentResponse(aMessage, aMessageInfo, keySequence);","note":"The packet is parsed as an MLE Parent Response and routed to the parent-response parser."},{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/openthread/src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"ot::Mle::Mle::HandleParentResponse","line":3216,"var":"response.GetResponse()","code":"memcmp(response.GetResponse(), mParentRequest.mChallenge, response.GetLength()) == 0","note":"The response TLV length is attacker-controlled within the parsed message, but the code compares that many bytes against the fixed-size stored challenge, creating the out-of-bounds read sink reported by ASAN."}]
